name: Product Page Customizer for WooCommerce
author: WebCartisan

sections.description:
Enhance WooCommerce product page with variations table, AJAX add to cart, quantity controls, custom tab and more.. for a better shopping experience.

Take full control of your WooCommerce single product pages with the WooCommerce Product Page Customizer plugin — the ultimate tool for store owners who want to optimize product pages for better conversions, send a beautiful message, different type of offer, without reload add-to-cart functionality and many more. 

The Most useful feature is WooCommerce Variation Swatches you can get here with radio, images, colors, and button features. 

Whether you’re aiming to improve user experience, increase sales conversion rates, or add stunning custom features, this plugin lets you effortlessly customize every element of your product page — no coding required!.

👉Plugin Demo|Documentation|Get Pro👈

✨ Key Features (Free Version):

🏆 ️Enable Plus, Minus Buttons for Increase Decrease Quantity
Add intuitive plus and minus buttons into the quantity field, making it easier for customers to increase or decrease the number of items they want to purchase.

👉Live Demo|Documentation

🏆 ️Change “Add to Cart” Button Text in Single Product Page
Easily modify the default “Add to Cart” button label to anything you like—such as “Buy Now,” “Get Yours,” or “Add to Bag”—to better suit your store’s tone and boost engagement. 

👉 Live Demo|Documentation

🏆 ️Hide Add to Cart Button in Detail Page
Remove the “Add to Cart” button from product pages when needed—great for showcasing upcoming products, displaying out-of-stock items, or creating a catalog-style store.   

👉 Live Demo|Documentation

🏆 ️Sale Badge Text Change in Single Product Page
Customize the default “Sale!” badge with your own text to better highlight discounts or match your store’s branding style.  
👉 Live Demo|Documentation

🏆 ️Out of Stock Text Change in Detail Page
Replace the default “Out of stock” message with your own custom text to match your brand voice or provide more helpful information to your customers.  
👉 Live Demo|Documentation

🏆 ️On Backorder Text Change in Single Product Page
Allow customers to add products to their cart without reloading the page, providing a smoother and faster shopping experience.  
👉 Live Demo|Documentation

🏆 ️Remove Product SKU, Category, Tag Name from Single Product Page
Clean up your product pages by hiding metadata like SKU, categories, and tags—perfect for a more minimal or customized layout  
👉 Live Demo|Documentation

🏆 ️Remove Related Product Section in Detail Page
Hide the “Related Products” section from your product pages to keep the focus on the main item or create a cleaner, distraction-free layout. 
👉 Live Demo|Documentation

🏆 ️Hide Price from Single Product Page
Temporarily hide product prices on the product page—ideal for showcasing exclusive items, encouraging customer inquiries for boosting your sale.   
👉 Live Demo|Documentation

🏆 ️Hide Short Description in Detail Page
Temporarily hide product short description on the product page—ideal for showcasing exclusive items, encouraging customer inquiries for boosting your sale.
👉 Live Demo|Documentation

🏆 ️Custom Message Show in Detail Page
Display personalized messages on your product pages, such as promotions, announcements, or special instructions, to enhance customer engagement and provide important information.
👉 Live Demo|Documentation

🏆 ️Variation Table Show for Variation Product in Detail Page
Display a clean, organized table of product variations (like size, color, or style) on your product page, helping customers easily compare options and make their selection. Also you can attach this variation table in anywhere in this single product page.
👉 Live Demo|Documentation

🏆 ️Variation Swatches for WooCommerce
Add a modern and user-friendly variation swatches to your product page, allowing customers to quickly select different attribute (such as size or color) without need to select option. Just click a button also this button will be an image button color button or radio. 
👉 Live Demo|Documentation

🏆 ️Customize Related Product Title in Detail Page
Easily change the default “Related Products” title to something more relevant or engaging, like “You May Also Like” or “Suggested For You,” to better align with your store’s style and encourage more purchases. 
👉 Live Demo|Documentation

🏆 ️Variation Reset Text Change in Detail Page
Change the default Reset Variations button text “Clear” to something more suited to your store, such as “Clear Selection” or “Reset Choices” giving customers a clearer and more intuitive way to reset their product options. 
👉 Live Demo|Documentation

✨ Pro Features:

🏆 ️Enable Min/Max Quantity Limits in Detail Page
Set minimum and maximum quantity limits for products, ensuring customers can only purchase within a specified range, whether globally or for specific products. Here you can set custom message about min max validation text and also you can setup quantity step.
👉 Live Demo|Documentation

🏆 ️Enable Ajax Add to Cart in Single Product Page
Allow customers to add products to their cart without reloading the page, providing a smoother and faster shopping experience.
👉 Live Demo|Documentation

🏆 ️Custom Tab Attach with Before Existing WooCommerce Tab in Detail Page
Add additional custom tabs to your product pages, allowing you to include extra information like specifications, FAQs, or special instructions in a well-organized and easy-to-navigate format.
👉 Live Demo|Documentation

🏆 ️Additional Content Attach in Detail Page into Any Place
Include extra informational sections on your product pages, such as detailed descriptions, guides, or promotions, to provide more value and enhance the shopping experience.
👉 Live Demo|Documentation

🏆 ️WooCommerce Default Tab Label Change
Customize the default labels for product tabs like “Description,” “Additional Information,” and “Reviews,” giving you full control over the text to better align with your brand or product details
👉 Live Demo|Documentation

🏆 ️Related Product Categories Show as a Grid Format in Detail Page
Show related product categories in a clean, organized grid layout on your product page, making it easier for customers to explore similar items and encouraging further browsing. 
👉 Live Demo|Documentation

🏆 ️Move Image Section to Right Side in Single Product Page
Change the layout of your product page by moving the product image section to the right side, allowing for a fresh, alternative design that better suits your store’s aesthetic. 
👉 Live Demo|Documentation

Watch WooCommerce Product Page Customizer All pro features
sections.installation:
1. Upload the Plugin Files:
    • Download the plugin ZIP file.
    • Go to your WordPress admin dashboard.
    • Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
    • Upload the ZIP file and click “Install Now.”
  2. Activate the Plugin:
    • After installation, click “Activate Plugin.”
  3. Install Required Plugins:
    • Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. Configure the Plugin:
    • Go to Dashboard > WooCommerce > Products to customize the plugin.
sections.faq:
What does WooCommerce Product Page Customizer do?

It gives you full control over your single product layout and features. You can customize the product page with a variation table, AJAX-powered add-to-cart, quantity plus minus (+/–) buttons, custom tabs, and extra content sections​. In practice, it lets you adjust or hide almost any element on the product page (price, SKU, short description, etc.) and add your own messages or layout tweaks for a better shopping experience. All these tools help improve the user experience and can boost conversions on your WooCommerce site​.

Is it compatible with my WordPress/WooCommerce site and themes?

The plugin is designed for WooCommerce and works with WordPress 4.0 or higher (tested With Latest version)​. It should work with any standard WooCommerce theme. However, note that because it relies on WooCommerce action hooks, it may not override product layouts that are fully built with page builders (Elementor, Divi, etc.). In sites where the entire product template is controlled by a builder, some customizations might not appear unless the builder’s template supports those WooCommerce hooks​.

Is mobile responsiveness supported?

Yes! All customizations are mobile-friendly by default. Preview and tweak designs for mobile devices directly in the editor.

Can I customize product badges, pricing, or stock messages?

Absolutely. For example, you can replace the default “Sale!” badge text with your own message and even hide the price display entirely if desired. You can also customize stock/status messages: the default “Out of Stock” or “On Backorder” text can be replaced with your own messages to better fit your brand.

How do I enable the plus/minus quantity buttons and set limits?

The plugin lets you turn on a quantity spinner with plus/minus controls for easier quantity selection. In the free version, you can simply enable these buttons (no coding needed). For advanced control, the Pro version adds min/max quantity limits and custom validation (so you can enforce minimum or maximum purchase amounts per product).

Can I change or hide the “Add to Cart” button, and use AJAX add-to-cart?

Yes. You can change the “Add to Cart” button text or hide the button entirely via the plugin’s settings​. This is useful if you want to replace it with a custom link or hide it until certain conditions are met. The plugin also supports AJAX add-to-cart (no page reloads) – this smooth, faster cart action is available in the Pro version​.

How can I hide product metadata or unwanted sections (SKU, categories, short description)?

The plugin provides simple toggles to remove or hide product meta information. You can strip out the product meta (SKU, categories, tags), disable the related products or upsells section, hide customer review stars, and even hide the short description​. This lets you declutter the page and focus customer attention on what matters.

Can I add custom messages or additional content to the product page?

instance, you might add a promotional banner, a guarantee message, or extra instructions next to the description. The plugin settings let you choose where this custom content appears. In the Pro version you can also create new custom tabs or rename existing ones (e.g. “Additional Information” or “Reviews”) to include extended content.

How can I customize product variations or related product sections?

You have multiple options: the plugin can enable a variation switcher or a variation table on the product page​. This displays product variations (sizes, colors, etc.) in a clean, user-friendly way. You can also change the “Reset Variations” button text, and rename the titles of the Related Products or Upsells sections (e.g. change “Related Products” to “You May Also Like”). These features help tailor the shopping experience around your product variations and recommendations.

Can I add custom fields (e.g., size charts, FAQs) to product pages?

Yes! Use the drag-and-drop editor to add custom text, images, buttons, or even shortcodes to any section of the product page.

Does the plugin slow down my site?

No. The plugin is optimized for performance and uses lightweight code to ensure fast loading times.

Do I need coding skills to use this plugin?

Not at all! The intuitive drag-and-drop interface lets anyone create professional product pages without writing a single line of code.

Is it compatible with page builders like Elementor?

Yes! The plugin integrates seamlessly with Elementor, Divi, and other popular page builders for advanced customization.

Can I create unique layouts for different products?

Definitely! Assign custom designs to specific products, categories, or tags using conditional logic.

Variation swatches is available?

Yes Variation Swatches is available in this plugin.

How to use WooCommerce variation swatches?

You need to install this plugin then go to advance settings section then check “Enable variation switcher”.

Can I add Additional tab with WooCommerce default tab?

Yes, you can add additional custom tab by using this plugin.

Is there a Pro version, and what additional features does it include?

A Pro (paid) version is available with advanced customization options. In addition to all the above, the Pro version lets you set global or product-specific min/max quantity limits and step values, show custom validation messages for quantity, and enable AJAX add-to-cart. It also unlocks category-based or per-product rules, the ability to add multiple custom tabs and content sections, and layout changes like moving the product image to the right side​. These extras give developers and designers even more control over the single-product page design and behavior.

Is the plugin actively maintained and where can I get support?

Yes, it is actively maintained: according to the plugin page it was updated recently (tested with latest version). The developer provides documentation on their site and you can ask questions or get help through the WordPress.org support forum for the plugin. Being open-source, any issues can also be tracked in the plugin’s development log on WordPress.org.
